property_summary: For any depositor and any deposited amount, the credited balance of that depositor must equal the Ether actually held by the contract (balances == address(c).balance); the mutant credits msg.value+1 to the mapping while only msg.value is received, so the equality breaks for every admissible deposit.
change_summary: Replace the deposited amount msg.value with msg.value + 1 in the balance update, crediting one wei more than sent.
